Created [calorimeter envelope input](docs/design/inputs/DES-003-calorimeter-envelope-input.md).

Key findings:

- ODD barrel radii are apothems; endcap outer radii use a different convention. Documented corner corrections.
- Retain inherited allocations as option C0; expanded C1 explicitly requires external-coil and muon-layout changes.
- Proposed depth comparison bands remain inferences, not containment guarantees.
- Flagged dense HCal PCB mixture, transition cracks, service accounting and forward coverage.
- Added precise ATLAS/CMS overview and HGCAL TDR locators.

No production changes or approvals. Whitespace checks and validation of 22 session records passed.
